audit_timeliness.description: Proportion of audit reports delivered on schedule relative to eligible completed audits.
audit_timeliness.operational_definition: Percentage of completed audits that were delivered on or before the committed due date within the evaluation cycle.

formula_variables.on_time_completed_audits: Count of completed audit reports delivered on or before contractual/statutory milestone date.
formula_variables.eligible_completed_audits: Total count of completed audits within the reporting period subject to delivery schedules.

missing_data_rule.explanation: If no audits were completed in the period, timeliness cannot be computed mathematically; record as NOT_ASSESSABLE.

partial_data_rule.explanation: In-progress audits without a completion date are excluded from the denominator.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: If on_time_completed_audits > eligible_completed_audits or value < 0, flag record as MALFORMED and set status to NOT_ASSESSABLE.

audit_timeliness.derivation_justification: Specified in Assignment 2 Section 2.1 / 5.2 as the proportion of on-time audits over completed audits, scaled to 0-100%.

audit_efficiency.description: Average duration in calendar days taken to complete an audit.
audit_efficiency.operational_definition: Arithmetic mean of the turnaround time (actual completion date minus audit start date) across all eligible completed audits.

formula_variables.actual_completion_date: Timestamp of formal audit report submission and sign-off.
formula_variables.audit_start_date: Timestamp of formal audit initiation / kick-off meeting.
formula_variables.eligible_completed_audits: Count of completed audits with valid start and completion timestamps.

missing_data_rule.explanation: When zero audits exist, duration is undefined. Recorded as NOT_ASSESSABLE to prevent silent zero distortion.

partial_data_rule.explanation: Individual audit records missing either start date or completion date are excluded from the summation.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: Negative durations (completion before start) or durations exceeding 365 days are flagged as MALFORMED and set to NOT_ASSESSABLE.

audit_efficiency.derivation_justification: Assignment 2 Section 2.1 / 5.2 defines efficiency as the average duration taken to complete an audit.

error_rate.description: Rate of discrepancies or quality non-conformances identified in reviewed audit reports.
error_rate.operational_definition: Ratio of total identified quality discrepancies to the total count of audited/reviewed reports.

formula_variables.identified_discrepancies: Total count of substantive errors, omissions, or non-conformances found in quality reviews.
formula_variables.reviewed_reports: Total count of audit reports subjected to peer review or quality assurance oversight.

missing_data_rule.explanation: If no reports have been reviewed by QA, error rate is unobservable; flagged as NOT_ASSESSABLE.

partial_data_rule.explanation: Reports currently undergoing QA review without finalized discrepancy counts are omitted.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: Negative discrepancy counts or ratios above synthetic ceiling (20.0) trigger MALFORMED data status.

error_rate.derivation_justification: Denominator choice (reviewed_reports rather than total audits) is an explicit submitter judgement to prevent penalising unreviewed audits.

agency_scale.description: Composite index reflecting organizational capacity via technical team size and operational experience.
agency_scale.operational_definition: Equally weighted sum of 50% normalized team-size component and 50% normalized years-operational component, scaled to 0-100.

formula_variables.team_size: Number of certified cybersecurity auditors employed full-time.
formula_variables.years_operational: Total continuous years of active cybersecurity auditing operations.
formula_variables.max_team_size_bound: Upper normalization benchmark for team size (set to 50 professionals).
formula_variables.max_years_bound: Upper normalization benchmark for operating experience (set to 20 years).

missing_data_rule.condition: both team_size and years_operational are missing
missing_data_rule.explanation: If organizational headcount and operational history are absent, agency scale cannot be established.

partial_data_rule.explanation: If one sub-metric is missing, the available sub-metric is scaled to 50% max and flagged with PARTIAL_DATA warning.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: Negative team size or negative operational years are rejected and flagged as MALFORMED.

agency_scale.derivation_justification: 50-50 equal weighting and upper benchmark bounds (50 team size, 20 years) are submitter proof-of-concept design judgements.

compliance_adherence.description: Level of adherence to established auditing standards, expressed as a percentage.
compliance_adherence.operational_definition: Proportion of applicable mandatory auditing control checkpoints fully met by the agency across periodic compliance reviews.

formula_variables.compliant_applicable_controls: Count of applicable standard control requirements verified as compliant.
formula_variables.applicable_controls: Total count of mandated audit standard controls applicable to the agency scope.

missing_data_rule.explanation: Where no compliance audit has occurred or applicable controls count is 0, status is NOT_ASSESSABLE.

partial_data_rule.explanation: Checklist evaluations must be complete before computing adherence.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: Compliant controls exceeding applicable controls or negative counts are flagged as MALFORMED.

compliance_adherence.derivation_justification: Specified in Assignment 2 Section 2.1 / 5.2 as compliance adherence expressed as a percentage.

past_renewal_status.description: Historical record of formal empanelment renewals versus revocations.
past_renewal_status.operational_definition: Percentage of successful renewal outcomes out of total definitive historical renewal/revocation decisions.

formula_variables.historical_renewals: Total cumulative count of past successful empanelment renewals.
formula_variables.historical_revocations: Total cumulative count of past empanelment revocations, cancellations, or terminations.

missing_data_rule.explanation: New entrant organizations with zero renewal/revocation history must NEVER be treated as renewed or revoked; they are strictly flagged as NOT_ASSESSABLE.

partial_data_rule.explanation: Pending renewal applications without final adjudication are excluded.

invalid_data_behaviour.action: Negative counts for renewals or revocations trigger MALFORMED data classification.

past_renewal_status.derivation_justification: Assignment 2 Section 5.2 mandates: if no historical decision exists, flag as NOT_ASSESSABLE. Never treat absent history as renewal or revocation.
